name: @gears-frontx/site-meta
description: Page metadata of a FrontX site: generates the document head, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, seo-manifest.json, the web manifest and the pages' plain-text twins from the screens' seo blocks and a site config, checks them, and carries the head-sync runtime that keeps the head equal to the current page. Delivered by @gears-frontx/frontx-template-site-meta.
